subject: delta(client): WF suspend queued work when the host stop refuses a purchase service action before it runs
note: The public purchase service checked the host stop before the original action ran, so a stopped protocolRecheck or agreementSubmit refused without recording a suspension, and once the stop was lifted verifyDeal continued the queued work with no explicit resume. A stop refusal raised by the admission wrapper of the service now suspends the queued work of the purchase its request names, with the refusal's code as cause, through the same suspendQueued write the continuation uses. A request that names no purchase it may act on records nothing, and a purchase already suspended keeps its suspension and id.
